cells.label: fact

items.text: Raymond James describes its independent advisor value proposition as 'A partnership in independence,' where affiliating as an independent contractor gives access to the firm's full capabilities at a level right for the advisor's business.
items.quote: A partnership in independence. Standing apart doesn't mean you need to stand alone. When you affiliate with Raymond James as an independent contractor, you can access our full capabilities at a level that's right for your business.

items.text: Raymond James describes 'Powerful independence' for independent advisors: serving clients and growing an independent practice without wanting for capability, with the support of a full-service, self-clearing NYSE-member broker/dealer.
items.quote: Powerful independence. Serve your clients and grow your independent practice without wanting for capability, expert insight or client resources. Everything we have is yours when you want it. Enjoy the rewards of running your own practice with the support of a full-service, self-clearing New York Stock Exchange-member broker/dealer.

items.text: Raymond James describes its value proposition as a unique combination of an advisor- and client-focused culture, coupled with leading technology and solutions, together with a strong balance sheet and commitment to independence.
items.quote: We offer a unique combination of an advisor and client-focused culture, coupled with leading technology and solutions. This value proposition, coupled with our strong balance sheet and commitment to independence, is proving to be a differentiator for advisors evaluating alternatives.

items.text: Raymond James describes its value proposition as 'best of both worlds,' offering a unique combination of an advisor- and client-focused culture coupled with leading technology and solutions, which resonates with advisors across all affiliation options.
items.quote: Our best-of-both-worlds value proposition, where we offer a unique combination of an advisor and client-focused culture coupled with leading technology and solutions, continues to resonate with advisors across all of our affiliation options.

items.text: Raymond James states advisers do not have to choose between culture and capabilities, offering a unique combination of an adviser- and client-focused culture together with leading technologies, products and solutions.
items.quote: At Raymond James, advisers do not have to choose between culture and capabilities. We offer a unique combination of an adviser and client-focused culture together with leading technologies, products and solutions advisers need to serve clients at a high level.

items.text: Raymond James describes its value proposition as the scope and breadth of products and capabilities to serve complex client needs, combined with a strong culture anchored on putting people first.
items.quote: We are unique in having the scope and breadth of products and capabilities to serve complex needs of clients, combined with our strong culture that is anchored on putting people first.

items.text: Raymond James describes attracting advisors through its unique culture, leading service, and robust platform, while valuing independence so advisors can provide objective advice to clients.
items.quote: We attract and retain financial advisors with our unique culture, leading service, and robust platform, whereas many of our competitors compete with the largest check. We value independence to foster an environment where our advisors can provide objective advice to their clients.

items.text: Raymond James describes its differentiation as its culture and the way its financial professionals and advisers serve clients through trusted, personal relationships that cannot be replicated by AI or technology.
items.quote: But what sets Raymond James apart is the same thing that has always set us apart, our culture and the way our financial professionals and advisers serve clients through trusted relationships. That can't be replicated by AI or technology, but it will be helped by AI and technology.

items.text: Raymond James describes focusing on 'the Power of Personal' personal relationships with financial advisors, combined with roughly $1 billion in technology investment, as its differentiator.
items.quote: we're focused on the long term, we're focused on the Power of Personal, the personal relationships, and we're able to invest $1 billion in technology.

items.text: Raymond James attributes its ability to attract high-quality advisors to its values-based culture, commitment to service, and the unique ways it provides services to financial advisors.
items.quote: Our ability to attract high quality advisors is based on our values-based culture, our commitment to service, and the unique ways in which we provide services to our financial advisors.

items.text: Raymond James describes a stable, long-term platform where advisors have confidence their business, team and clients will have a stable platform for the long-term as what resonates most with advisors.
items.quote: Having a stable platform like Raymond James, where they have confidence that their business, their employees, their team, and most importantly, their clients will have a stable platform for the long-term, is really what resonates the most.

cells.reason: The passages contain multiple explicit statements by Raymond James describing its value proposition to advisors (including independent advisors), so these are facts.
